text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — EUW1 probe cluster 'health-checkers' reporting silent telemetry for ~15m (alerts: probe.missing_heartbeat, probe.dns_fail_rate). Root TS: 2067890123

maya: seeing pagers, jumping in. dashboards show EUW1 probe heartbeats flatline around 00:42 UTC.

sam: I'm on-call now, looking into it. Ctrl plane looks healthy; controller logs don't show OOMs/crashes. Some probes returning 502/503 to route53 healthchecks.

oliver: checked Route53 healthchecks history — no config changes in the last 24h. Could be network ACL or cloud egress issue.

maya: also no telemetry hitting our ingestion (kinesis) from those probe host-tags, so might be agent -> ingest path or agent-level DNS failure.

sam: can someone run the agent logs? `kubectl -n probes logs probe-azb-1 | tail -n 200`

maya: logs snippet:```
2026-03-15T00:40:12Z WARN upstream connect timeout
2026-03-15T00:40:13Z ERROR dns lookup failed: i/o timeout
2026-03-15T00:40:14Z INFO heartbeat sent
2026-03-15T00:40:15Z INFO heartbeat ack missing
```

aj: I'm seeing outgoing SKB drops from nodes in EUW1 on our flow logs — `tcp_reset` spikes line up with the missing heartbeats.

sam: that suggests provider-side egress issues. I'll open a ticket with cloud provider netops and attach flow logs. Ticket: CP-48291. @oliver add healthcheck IDs.

oliver: added IDs: `/healthchecks/rdw-euw1-probe-01`, `/healthchecks/rdw-euw1-dns-quick`. Also flipped monitoring policy to use euw2-external-checks as temporary fallback for customer-facing checks.

oncall-shift-bot: Handing off to night oncall: liam (12:00-20:00UTC).

liam: taking over. TL;DR for handoff: silent telemetry on probes in EUW1, intermittent 502s to Route53, missing ingestion. Mitigation: reroute healthchecks to EUW2, cloud ticket opened, rolling restarts in EUW1 underway. No confirmed customer outage but elevated error rate ~0.7% on tokenization service for EUW1 tenants.

maya: affected customers are a small subset behind legacy peering — increased latency and occasional failed DNS lookups observed. Not a full outage but user-visible degradation in some regions.

sam: immediate action plan:
1) keep euw2 reroute in place
2) rolling restart probe agents in EUW1
3) increase probe aggregation window to 10m to suppress noisy pages
4) attach flow logs and packet captures to CP ticket

liam: performing rolling restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/probe-agent -n probes --selector=region=euw1`

oliver: after restart, heartbeats returned for ~5 nodes but still missing on 7 nodes. Flow logs show packet loss between those nodes and provider edge.

liam: I am opening a temporary alert suppression for EUW1 to avoid paging while we coordinate with provider. Disabling `probe.missing_heartbeat` for 30m (patch AA-744).

maya: :thumbsup: please create an incident record and post to #incidents. I'll start a short blameless incident note.

sam: ETA for next update 30m or when cloud provider responds. tagging netops and eng-sre for visibility.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1284, severity: P2, channel: #incidents. Pager escalations configured.

liam: update +30m — cloud provider acknowledges suspected maintenance affecting TCP egress on a subset of AZ egress paths in EUW1. They estimate ~1h to fully remediate. We keep euw2 fallback until provider confirms.

maya: noted. Postmortem owners: sam, oliver. Assigning to eng-sre. Action items: add runbook detection for provider-side TCP resets and early warning, update monitoring to correlate SKB resets with missing heartbeats.

oliver: creating runbook PR now and attaching notes to INC-2026-1284.

liam: handing off coverage in 1h. I'll update the incident channel and leave the euw2 fallback in place.
